items.t: How Investors May Respond To Broadcom (AVGO) As Nvidia Rivals Gain Attention
items.sum: In early November 2026, Traefik Labs disclosed broad availability of Traefik Hub across VMware Cloud Foundation from Broadcom, SUSE AI Factory with NVIDIA, Spectro Cloud PaletteAI and Nutanix. Broadcom separately reported that its VM API project entered the CNCF Sandbox and that more than 20 partner offerings were validated for VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service. These steps deepen Broadcom’s role
One Wall Street analyst has concerns about the semiconductor and networking specialist.

items.t: Broadcom Stocks Fall 4.59% as 24% Weekly Rally Cools Before Nvidia Results
items.sum: The custom-chip leader gives back part of Thursday's 5.54% surge, with Nvidia's Tuesday report now the key test for the rotation trade.

items.t: Is Rothschild & Co Redburn Wrong to Give Up on Broadcom? Wall Street Still Sees $533
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRothschild & Co Redburn downgraded Broadcom to Neutral from Buy on Nov. 13 and cut its price target to $398 from $595, 9% above the Nov.

items.t: AMD Tumbles 11%, Broadcom and Intel Slide 6% as Chip Rally Reverses
items.sum: One day after NVIDIA's CEO shake-up handed its rivals a windfall, the winners are giving it back fast. Analysts and a famed skeptic disagree on what comes next, and the answer may hinge on who sold first.

items.t: Broadcom Sinks 7% as Rothschild Redburn Downgrade Slashes Target to $398: “Unlikely to Occur Quickly”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysBroadcom fell 7% today after Rothschild & Co Redburn cut it to Neutral and lowered its target to $398 from $595. Redburn says Broadcom’s AI growth depends on Anthropic and OpenAI paying their own way, and doesn’t expect that quickly.
